content.text: The campaign is live: both ad groups are active, targeting UK and Ireland, with a combined $350 budget across the 12 days. I'll check on it through the flight.

Early read after about 13 hours: post 1 has 4 "Release opened" conversions for $5.42. Post 2 has 4,588 impressions and no link clicks or conversions yet, so I'll let it run and check again before moving money.

Day 2 check: both ad groups are delivering evenly and at similar cost per stream. Post 1 has 5 streams for $19.78, and post 2 has 5 for $19.84. Combined spend is about $39.62 of $350. Neither has enough data to reallocate yet, so I'll keep both running.

After about 3.5 days, post 1 has 18 streams at $2.69 each and post 2 has 13 at $3.72 each. The gap is still small, but post 1 is cheaper per stream, so I'll shift daily budget toward it. Both ad groups keep their total caps and the account stays within $350.

Through July 25: $155.16 spent, 52 streams. Post 1 is at $2.79 per stream and post 2 at $3.33. Post 1 has been spending about $14.50 a day against its $24 cap, so I'll raise its daily cap to $30 to use the remaining budget on the cheaper post. Post 2 stays at $6.

content.text: The stats API caps the window at about 7 days, so I'll pull the last few days and add them to the earlier totals.

Through July 28 at noon, the campaign has spent about $216 with 74 streams. Post 1 is cheaper per stream (about $2.77 against $3.23), so I'm moving the remaining headroom toward it. Post 2 gets a lower cap so it doesn't take budget from post 1.
The flight has ended. I'll pull the final segment (July 28 noon to the end of July 30 BST) to finish the totals.

The campaign ran from July 19 to July 30 (BST) and spent $344.41 of the $350 budget. It delivered 106 "Release opened" streams, about $3.25 per stream.

**Final recap**

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $344.41 |
| Impressions | 353,261 |
| Link clicks | 222 |
| Streams ("Release opened") | 106 |

By post:

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Streams | Cost per stream |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2209437818680962828 ("A song for the long evenings") | $255.11 | 258,639 | 163 | 78 | about $3.27 |
| 2209619012615350526 ("Last Light on the Towpath: my debut folk single") | $89.30 | 94,622 | 59 | 28 | about $3.19 |

Of the 106 streams, 92 came from people who engaged with the post and 14 from people who saw it without engaging (the pixel's 1-day view-through window).

**What I set up**
- One campaign, "Last Light on the Towpath - Streams 19-30 Jul 2027", billed to the Visa ending 8448.
- Two ad groups, one per approved post, both optimised for website conversions on the "Release opened" pixel, targeting the United Kingdom and Ireland, and both ending at midnight BST on July 31.
- Both posts were approved by X, and I didn't write any new copy.

**How I managed it**
- On July 22, after the first few days, the first post was the cheaper stream, so I moved budget toward it. I raised its daily cap from $14.58 to $24, then $30, then $60, and set its lifetime cap to $260. I reduced the second post's daily cap to $6 and its lifetime cap to $90.
- Those changes stayed within the $350 total, and nothing was paused.

Two things to note. First, the stream count is what the pixel reports, so it's the number to trust for your plays. Second, I can only send this recap here in this chat. I don't have a way to email it to you.
